name: Tomato and cheese pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to the package and drain.
Chop tomatoes and simmer in olive oil until softened.
Toss with pasta and top with cheese.

name: Tomato toast
instructions: Toast the bread.
Chop tomatoes, mix with olive oil, and spoon over toast.

name: Cheese toast
instructions: Place cheese on bread.
Toast under a grill until the cheese melts.

name: Tomato rice
instructions: Cook rice according to the package.
Soften chopped onion in olive oil, then add chopped tomatoes and simmer.
Stir the cooked rice into the tomato mixture.

name: Bean and cheese wrap
instructions: Drain and rinse canned beans, then warm in a pan.
Place beans and cheese in tortillas, fold, and heat until cheese melts.

name: Chickpea and tomato salad
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas.
Chop tomatoes and cucumber.
Toss with chickpeas, olive oil, and lemon juice.

name: Potato and onion soup
instructions: Soften chopped onion in olive oil.
Add diced potatoes and enough vegetable broth to cover.
Simmer until potatoes are tender, then mash some for a thicker soup.

name: Spinach and cheese pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to the package, reserving a little cooking water.
Wilt spinach in olive oil.
Toss pasta and spinach with cheese and a splash of cooking water.

name: Vegetable rice bowl
instructions: Cook rice according to the package.
Cook frozen vegetables according to their package.
Combine and add soy sauce to taste.

name: Banana oatmeal
instructions: Cook oats with milk according to the oat package directions.
Slice banana and stir it into the warm oatmeal.

name: Yogurt and banana bowl
instructions: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with sliced banana and oats.

name: Bean topped baked potato
instructions: Scrub and pierce potatoes, then bake at 400 F until tender.
Drain and rinse beans and warm in a pan.
Split potatoes and top with beans and cheese.
